warnings.message: No colour reference was present in the frame, so the image could not be corrected for the light source. Colour values are device- and lighting-dependent.

limitations: This is an image-based screening estimate, not a chemically confirmed measurement. It must not be used on its own to declare a sample safe, unsafe, compliant or non-compliant.
Produced by colour-distance matching against reference levels. No trained predictive model was used, and no concentration was estimated.
The test method "BROMATE-COLOUR-SCREEN" has validation status DRAFT. No limit of detection, calibration curve or measurement uncertainty has been established for it in this system.

Reference chart "Illustrative bromate colour ladder" is marked ILLUSTRATIVE: its colours were read from a picture rather than measured from prepared standards. It establishes no validated relationship between colour and potassium bromate (reported as BrO3-) concentration.
Model "baseline-color-analysis" v0.1.0 has not been validated against confirmed laboratory measurements.
Not a trained model: computes a CIEDE2000 distance between the measured colour and each reference level.
Returns no concentration estimate and no confidence value, because neither is supported by a colour distance alone.
Accuracy depends entirely on the reference chart's own validity, the imaging conditions and the sample preparation.
"Very High Level" and "High Level" are nearly equidistant from the measured colour (ΔE 11.75 vs 13.20). The match between them is not supported by this measurement.
Test method BROMATE-COLOUR-SCREEN has validation status DRAFT.
The reference chart used is not a validated reference (status: ILLUSTRATIVE).
Confirm any actionable result with a validated analytical method and record it under laboratory measurements.
